The surrounding text also says the objective should “enforce alignment” and “preserve adversarial behavior while enforcing target alignment,” which conflicts with minimizing the negative of the defined loss.
reply.explanation: The paragraph describes the D-UAP step as minimizing the negative of a cosine-similarity loss together with CroPA, but the paper’s formal definition of \(L_{d\text{-}UAP}\) is already a distance-style loss \(1-\)cosine similarity. Subtracting that term in the combined objective reverses the intended effect, so the text and equations disagree about whether the term is being minimized for alignment or effectively maximized.
